decision_conditions:
The proposed works are not sufficiently detailed to allow assessment. Please provide measurable and quantifiable specifications, including the current and proposed height and crown spread of the trees following the works.

Where crown reductions are proposed, please specify the extent of pruning and the resulting crown dimensions. For example: reduce the crown by 2m in height and 2m in spread, leaving a final height of 10m and crown spread of 8m.
description:
See Map
G1-Ash and Cherry
Reduce trees on building side from 6 metres by up to 3 metres leaving a finishing length of 3 metres.

G1 is a group of 2 trees, 1 ash, 1 cherry located out the front of 20 austin close.
The crowns of the trees are unbalanced and are heavily encroaching onto the building with potential to cause damage to the roof in the near future.
The works are part of a regular maintenance programme.
The works will improve the aesthetics of the tree.

G2-2xHorse chestnut, 1x Laurel
Cut Laural back from building to give 2 metres clearance , starting length 3 metres, finshing length 1 metre and lateral reduce 2x Chestnuts by 2 metres. Starting length 5 metres, finshing length 3 metres.

G2 is a group of 3 trees, 1 Laurel and 2 horse chestnuts located at the rear of 20 austin close.
The crowns of the trees are heavily encroaching onto the building with potential to cause damage to the roof in the near future.
The works are part of a regular maintenance programme.
The works will improve the aesthetics of the tree.

Amended
